ownership_boundaries: Public issuer EPS/rights dilution belongs to public-markets; private contractual ownership and preference rights remain here.
Operating-credit owns DSCR,CFADS,DSRA,loan-life cover and payment waterfall; this shard owns net leverage, EBITDA-only cure and deal/fund cash mechanisms.
method_risks: No generic LBO, cap-table, deal-memo or valuation clone.
Actual signed contract definitions control; ILPA/NVCA/YC source documents are references, not universal defaults or legal authority.
Single-class preferences do not solve stacked series; no-catchup fund tiers do not solve GP catch-up.
Pre-topup reserve target differs from post-financing target; same port label never establishes same denominator.
Cure cash is not also debt netting; funded, approved and proposed cash are separate.
Periodic annual IRR is distinct from XIRR on irregular dated receipts.
Baseline and perturbation figures are clearly illustrative and not investment recommendations.

agent_reviews.trigger: A new funded SAFE, signed round term, pool target or approved participation right is supplied.
agent_reviews.branch: If a qualifying down round changes protected conversion ratios, run the actual charter reset check and require an approved revised capitalization denominator before rerunning affected SAFE, pool or allocation work. Otherwise skip the antidilution branch. Never infer multiple-class ownership from the single-SAFE example.
agent_reviews.memory: Instrument IDs, received funding dates, cap version, approved capitalization source, pool target date, side-letter eligibility and unresolved conversion conditions.
agent_reviews.acceptance: Use actual contract denominators; keep pool expansion and financing dilution separate and never treat illustrative defaults as deal facts. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.

agent_reviews.trigger: The note accrual cutoff, interest conversion election, discount term or approved cap price changes.

agent_reviews.memory: Note version, funded principal source, accrual start/end dates, day count, price approvals, balance converted and actual rounding status.
agent_reviews.acceptance: Convert only interest the note permits and use an independently checked cap price, not a guessed valuation denominator. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agent_reviews.judgment: Evidence-triggered portable assistant; no account write, trading action, sent notice or installed schedule.

agent_reviews.trigger: A revised closing statement, final working-capital determination, paid claim or signed fee amendment arrives.
agent_reviews.branch: If the adviser fee changed, recompute only the supported marginal tier schedule and update unpaid seller expenses using the net remaining invoice. Preserve paid retainers and prior settlement records to prevent duplicate deductions. Otherwise leave the fee branch unrun.
agent_reviews.memory: Closing version, cutoff, price-bridge clause IDs, prior paid adjustments, final working-capital status, escrow claim IDs and invoice credit evidence.
agent_reviews.acceptance: Working-capital amounts already paid and actual escrow disbursements appear once; final settlement signs and payer are explicit. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agent_reviews.judgment: Evidence-triggered portable assistant; no account write, trading action, sent notice or installed schedule.

agent_reviews.trigger: A new seller-benefit transfer, permitted-item consent, verified repayment or ticking-day confirmation is supplied.
agent_reviews.branch: If unrecovered leakage has a specific approved escrow reserve, reconcile only that account and claim ledger before proposing a release or collateral shortfall. If no dedicated escrow or authority is evidenced, return a question and never divert an unrelated earnout or indemnity account.
agent_reviews.memory: Locked-box period, transfer IDs, permitted-item evidence, recovery dates, unique deductions, eligible ticking days and any dedicated escrow source.
agent_reviews.acceptance: Recoveries and ticking amounts are sourced once; the actual agreement determines whether the daily amount applies to original or adjusted price. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agent_reviews.judgment: Evidence-triggered portable assistant; no account write, trading action, sent notice or installed schedule.

agent_reviews.trigger: A lender sends revised issue proceeds, a payoff letter, fee invoice or confirmed closing date.
agent_reviews.branch: If a capitalized PIK interval explains changed old principal, verify the supported single-period cash/PIK calculation and then obtain the actual revised payoff letter. Never add illustrative accrual to a legally binding payoff amount or count the same charge again as a closing fee.
agent_reviews.memory: Debt identifiers, funding status, face versus cash proceeds, fee-netting flags, payoff cutoff, capitalized PIK evidence and closing sources gap.
agent_reviews.acceptance: Financing and payoff fees are deducted once; face debt never substitutes for usable funding cash. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agent_reviews.judgment: Evidence-triggered portable assistant; no account write, trading action, sent notice or installed schedule.

agent_reviews.trigger: A new covenant certificate, supported addback, eligible cash balance, cure receipt or debt prepayment record is supplied.
agent_reviews.branch: If a sweep is proposed, calculate the bounded cash-floor scenario but preserve the actual debt baseline. If it is evidenced as paid, update only the dated debt and cash components and rerun leverage. Cure eligibility and timing still require the actual agreement; scenario cash never becomes compliance evidence.
agent_reviews.memory: Test date, covenant version, EBITDA adjustment IDs, eligible cash, netting cap, paid-versus-proposed sweep, cure deadline and evidence of receipt.
agent_reviews.acceptance: No addback is admitted without evidence and no cure is treated as received, timely or legally effective without proof. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agent_reviews.judgment: Evidence-triggered portable assistant; no account write, trading action, sent notice or installed schedule.

agent_reviews.acceptance: Use only a sole-sponsor plus simple management award structure; other rollover holders or preferences require a full ownership allocation first. Never overwrite an accepted baseline with an unapproved scenario; record which branch ran or was skipped.
agent_reviews.judgment: Evidence-triggered portable assistant; no account write, trading action, sent notice or installed schedule.
